thread:
Priyanka: Quick ask — I'm returning from 8w parental leave next month at 0.6 FTE and also on the on-call rotation. Can we get accommodation for overnight shifts (I have a newborn at home)? Also curious if there's any childcare stipend for occasional overnight coverage.

Jon (Eng Manager): Priyanka, thanks for flagging. I can remove you from overnight on-call for the first 6 weeks after return. Want to confirm with People Ops/Benefits on stipend rules.

Marta (Benefits): We can provide a temporary childcare stipend for eligible families in exceptional cases (e.g., overnight coverage) subject to manager approval and budget. It's not automatic; please have Jon submit a short justification (1-2 sentences) and dates.

Marta (Benefits): If you receive stipend, it's treated as a taxable benefit and will show on payroll. We'll confirm amount after approval.

Diego (Payroll): If approved, payroll code will be `FAM_STIPEND` and it'll be paid on the next regular pay date after approval. Please include effective start/end dates so we can process.

Priyanka: Thanks all. Jon I'll DM the exact overnight dates and proposed 6-week accommodation window.

Jon (Eng Manager): DM received. I'll file the manager justification in the finance intake form and set up coverage. Also tagging rotation owners to adjust schedule.

People Ops Bot: Policies: parental leave & accommodations: https://redwood.example.company/hr/parental-leave; one-off stipend policy: https://redwood.example.company/hr/stipends. Attach approval comments to the intake form.

Priyanka: Appreciate it. Removing overnight shifts for the return period helps a ton.

(End of thread)
